newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 18.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 18.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Tuesday:
* U.S. financial markets were closed on Monday for the President's Day holiday. On Friday, the Dow Jones fell 33.48 points to 6,988.96. PLDT's ADR dropped $1 1/8 to $60.
* The peso closed up at 26.344 to a U.S. dollar from 26.345.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange composite index shed 7.46 points to 3,314.85.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average was up at 10.5625 at 10.53125 percent.
* Businessworld said Engineering Equipment Inc posted a net income of 264.2 million pesos in 1996 from the year-ago 152.5 million pesos.
*The Philippines' benchmark 91-day Treasury bill rate rose to an average of 10.661 percent at the regular weekly auction from the previous 10.653 percent, the Bureau of Treasury said on Monday.
*The Manila Times newspaper said unaudited net of Reynolds Philippines Corp in 1996 rose to 190.2 million peso from 107.43 million pesos the previous year.
